name: tui.channel

operations.name: subscribe
operations.input: channel id and last observed version

operations.name: invoke
operations.output: method progress, JSON result and optional snapshot

concurrency: state mutations are serialized per channel; independent read operations may run concurrently
timeout: the caller supplies connection invocation cancellation; subscriptions remain open until cancelled or closed
cleanup: connection close or facet deactivate releases subscriptions, uploads and channel attachments
